name: io.github.sepehr071/mrbilit-mcp
title: MrBilit
description: Unofficial read-only MrBilit: Iranian flights, trains, buses, taxis and hotels, seats and prices.

environmentVariables.name: MRBILIT_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL, or a comma-separated list used one at a time and rotated on a block or connect error (only needed if your network cannot reach MrBilit's API servers). System proxy settings are ignored.
